questions.title: Convert Binary to Decimal
questions.statement:
Convert a binary number to its decimal equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 1010 → Output: 10
- Input: 1111 → Output: 15
- Input: 10000 → Output: 16
questions.inputFormat: A binary number as a string.

questions.title: Decimal to Binary conversion
questions.statement:
Convert a decimal number to its binary equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 10 → Output: 1010
- Input: 15 → Output: 1111
- Input: 16 → Output: 10000
questions.outputFormat: Return the binary equivalent as a string.

questions.title: Convert binary to octal
questions.statement:
Convert a binary number to its octal equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 110101 → Output: 65
- Input: 111000 → Output: 70
questions.inputFormat: A binary number as a string.

questions.title: Convert decimal to octal
questions.statement:
Convert a decimal number to its octal equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 10 → Output: 12
- Input: 64 → Output: 100

questions.title: Convert octal to decimal
questions.statement:
Convert an octal number to its decimal equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 12 → Output: 10
- Input: 100 → Output: 64
questions.inputFormat: An octal number as a string.

questions.title: Convert octal to binary
questions.statement:
Convert an octal number to its binary equivalent.

**Examples:**
- Input: 65 → Output: 110101
- Input: 70 → Output: 111000
questions.inputFormat: An octal number as a string.

questions.title: Convert digits/numbers to words
questions.statement:
Convert a number to its English word representation.

**Examples:**
- Input: 123 → Output: One Hundred Twenty Three
- Input: 1000 → Output: One Thousand
- Input: 0 → Output: Zero
